shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -50

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/ | grep -i -E 'dialog|modal|button' && sed -n 1,80p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Dialog/Dialog.d.ts

(ls node_modules/.bin | grep -i -E 'playwright|puppeteer'; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null) ; echo "---"; head -40 __agent_eval__/run.mjs
